description: Na₃In(PO₄)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent InO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.55 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.86 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.92 Å. In is bonded to six O atoms to form InO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of In-O bond distances ranging from 2.16-2.21 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and corners with three equivalent InO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 42-58°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.58 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and corners with three equivalent InO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 39-54°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.58 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one In, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one In, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one In, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one In, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to four Na and one P atom.
